plan.path_clock: s=cumulative absolute command-voltage distance inside each branch; no measured seconds
plan.lambda_range_scope: Finite effective exploration domain, not microscopic or experimental bound; no expansion
plan.interpolation: piecewise linear u, v, log I; surrogate path does not enforce intermediate KCL/readout
plan.loss: mean(((alpha*E-beta*C-delta_u)/delta_s)^2), 24 equal interval weights; not current RMSE
plan.regression: 82 two-column nonnegative linear regressions, finite active-set enumeration, no iterative optimizer
plan.seed_rule: each fixed low/middle/high lambda band overall minimum; if zero/degenerate no replacement; at most three
plan.budget_start: after frozen input validation, source hashes and plan persistence
plan.peak_state_scope: two observed peak endpoints kept separate for interpolation; actual forward must still connect continuously

seeds.selection: Lowest primary 16-point integral rate mismatch in fixed lambda bin; zero/degenerate bin winner not replaced
seeds.scope: Conditional integral initializer, not an ODE trajectory or current prediction
